description: This file contains a C# implementation of an in-memory storage provider with configurable latency for the Orleans framework. It includes options class, storage class, and related methods for reading, writing, and clearing grain state with simulated latency.

classes.name: MemoryStorageWithLatencyOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for the MemoryGrainStorageWithLatency, including default latency and mocking call behavior.

classes.name: MemoryGrainStorageWithLatency
classes.description: An in-memory storage provider that introduces fixed latency to simulate storage delay, useful in testing scenarios.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads grain state data with simulated latency.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Writes grain state data with simulated latency.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Clears grain state data with simulated latency.

methods.name: MakeFixedLatencyCall
methods.description: Helper method that enforces the fixed latency during storage operations and handles exceptions.
